messages:
Aisha: Quick sync on autofallback UX — can we make the operator inbox entry super terse but actionable? Need: human reason, rule name, two suggested actions.

Ben: Yes. Collapsed line: "Fallback — rule: latency-cutoff (autoswitch-90s) — reason: p95 spike". Actions: Inspect / Retry / Pin.

Clara: Telemetry: include p50/p95 latencies, recent error pct, and a small `trace_id` link. Dont include raw user content unless redacted.

deploy-bot: (deploy) autofallback policy rollout v3.0 -> canary 12% routes.

Aisha: Important: Retry should show estimated quota impact and whether it will re-hit the same model or bypass to a cheaper variant.

Ben: Sampling idea: default 0.5% route-hash sampling, up to 100% for routes with sustained fallback >0.4% over 15min. Operator 'Inspect' toggles full capture for that request id for 10m.

Diego: API: prefer /operator/actions {ack,inspect,override} separate from /rollouts so audit events don't mix with config changes. Overrides must require ops:override and write an immutable audit row.

Clara: Add trace labels: fallback.trigger, fallback.rule, fallback.confidence, sample.rate. Also add small privacy blurb when payload is redacted: "Payload redacted to protect users; request replay requires approval."

Aisha: OK actionables: Diego -> draft OpenAPI for /operator/actions; Clara -> trace label patch + blurb; Ben -> quick inbox wireframe; Aisha -> PR with retry quota modal copy. Sync Wed 11am. :thumbsup:
